items.reply: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P'

SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC'
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS'
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0
SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, sev_lvl, categ_cd FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59'
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC, tkt_id ASC
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt, reason_cd FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, method_cd, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC
SELECT rule_id, rule_key, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2026-02-01' AND (eff_to >= '2026-02-01' OR eff_to IS NULL)
SELECT evt_id, tkt_id, evt_ts, actor_emp_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'CLOSE' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, evt_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'I' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt, decided_dt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'D' ORDER BY decided_dt DESC, rfd_id ASC
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC, sku ASC
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL' AND sev_lvl = 1 ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC
SELECT c.cust_id, c.month_dt, c.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist c JOIN cust_master m ON c.cust_id = m.cust_id WHERE m.region_cd = 'NA' AND c.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND c.segment_cd = 'VIP'
SELECT evt_id, session_id, cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-01 23:59:59' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC
SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL'
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt
SELECT req_dt, rfd_amt, SUM(rfd_amt) OVER (ORDER BY req_dt, rfd_id) AS running_total FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY req_dt, rfd_id
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS prev_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr
SELECT ord_status, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT ord_status, ord_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr) t WHERE rn <= 2
SELECT ord_id, line_no, unit_prc, MAX(unit_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id) AS max_unit_prc FROM ord_line
SELECT dept_cd, emp_nm, hire_dt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_cd ORDER BY hire_dt ASC) AS hire_rank FROM emp
SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts, LEAD(opened_ts) OVER (ORDER BY opened_ts, tkt_id) AS next_opened_ts FROM support_tkt
SELECT ord_id, sku, qty AS line_qty, (qty * 100.0 / SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY sku)) AS pct_contribution FROM ord_line
SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM (SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_cd ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC) AS rn FROM refund_req) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC
SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS cumulative_total FROM ord_hdr
SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_cd ORDER BY emp_id) AS emp_row_num FROM emp
SELECT rfd_id, req_dt, rfd_amt, LAG(rfd_amt) OVER (ORDER BY req_dt, rfd_id) AS prev_rfd_amt FROM refund_req
SELECT status_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM (SELECT status_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status_cd ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC) AS rn FROM refund_req) t WHERE rn <= 3

SELECT ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS running_total, AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30'
SELECT tkt_id, categ_cd, opened_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LAG(opened_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY opened_ts, tkt_id), opened_ts) AS hours_since_prev FROM support_tkt
SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, signup_dt FROM (SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, signup_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_cd ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS rn FROM cust_master) t WHERE rn = 1
SELECT l.ord_id, l.line_no, (l.qty * l.unit_prc) AS line_value, ((l.qty * l.unit_prc) * 100.0 / SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY l.ord_id)) AS pct_of_order FROM ord_line l

SELECT approver_emp_id AS emp_id, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_approved_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(rfd_amt) DESC) AS rank_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY approver_emp_id
SELECT wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP'
SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT DISTINCT carrier_cd FROM shipment
SELECT ord_id, pay_amt, currency_cd FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'PP'
SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL'
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_inventory FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_inventory DESC

SELECT p.pay_id, p.pay_amt, SUM(p.pay_amt) OVER (ORDER BY p.paid_ts, p.pay_id) AS running_total FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON p.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' ORDER BY p.paid_ts, p.pay_id
SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, LAG(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS prev_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) AS rnk FROM inventory
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) as rnk FROM inventory) t WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, LEAD(pay_amt) OVER (ORDER BY paid_ts, pay_id) AS next_pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND DATE(paid_ts) = '2025-11-01' ORDER BY paid_ts, pay_id
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd
SELECT ord_id, channel_cd, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr)
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amt, (SUM(pay_amt) / (SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment)) * 100 AS pct_share FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd
SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rn FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rn <= 2
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, SUM(on_hand_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY sku) AS running_total FROM inventory
SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt, LAG(ship_dt) OVER (ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id) AS prev_ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id
SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) AS rnk FROM ord_hdr

SELECT ord_dt, ord_id, ord_total_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_dt ORDER BY ord_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id
SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, pay_amt - MAX(pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id) AS diff_from_max FROM payment
SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS cumulative_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W3' ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id
SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM (SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY pay_amt DESC) as rn FROM payment) t WHERE rn <= 3
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ord_total_amt / (SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB') AS ratio FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB'
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS active_cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY active_cust_count DESC, region_cd ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY product_count DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_orders DESC, channel_cd ASC
SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ord_status ASC
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_price DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS unique_customers FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01'
SELECT currency_cd, MIN(ord_total_amt) AS min_amount, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_amount FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_count DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY cust_count DESC, tier_cd ASC
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY channel_cd HAVING SUM(ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY total_amt DESC, channel_cd ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING AVG(unit_prc) > 100.00 ORDER BY avg_unit_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_count, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_total_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(ord_id) >= 1 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, cust_id ASC
SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fx_rate WHERE eff_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY record_count DESC, currency_cd ASC
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 60.00 ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT t1.ord_status, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.sku) AS distinct_sku_count FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.ord_status ORDER BY distinct_sku_count DESC, t1.ord_status ASC
SELECT region_cd, tier_cd, is_actv, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY region_cd, tier_cd, is_actv ORDER BY region_cd ASC, tier_cd ASC, is_actv ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty * unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty * unit_prc) > 300.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, sku ASC

SELECT t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_spending FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY total_spending DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT t1.region_cd, MAX(t2.ord_total_amt) AS max_ord_amt FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY max_ord_amt DESC, t1.region_cd ASC
SELECT t1.categ_cd, AVG(t2.disc_pct) AS avg_disc_pct FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.disc_pct > 0 GROUP BY t1.categ_cd ORDER BY avg_disc_pct DESC, t1.categ_cd ASC
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ord_count, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_total_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING AVG(ord_total_amt) > 300.00 ORDER BY avg_total_amt DESC, cust_id ASC
SELECT t1.categ_cd, SUM(t2.qty) AS total_units FROM prod_catalog t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.categ_cd ORDER BY total_units DESC, t1.categ_cd ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT t1.tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS ordering_cust_count FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY ordering_cust_count DESC, t1.tier_cd ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1
SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0
SELECT code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'ORD_STATUS' AND code_val = 'D'
SELECT list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE prod_nm = 'Atlas USB Hub'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT'
SELECT ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001'
SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-29' GROUP BY cust_id
SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sku = 'ELC-026' GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT t1.ord_id, SUM(t2.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-02-23' GROUP BY t1.ord_id
SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY c.tier_cd
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) AS distinct_orders FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ship_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY carrier_cd

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, p.total_pay_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN (SELECT ord_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id) p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt = '2026-01-08'

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, p.total_pay_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN (SELECT ord_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id) p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31'
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) AS distinct_orders, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT h.ord_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_line l WHERE l.ord_id = h.ord_id) AS line_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment s WHERE s.ord_id = h.ord_id) AS shipment_count FROM ord_hdr h WHERE h.ord_dt = '2026-07-23'

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT p.promo_id) AS promo_count FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_promo p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.promo_id) > 1

SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc * (1 - l.disc_pct / 100)) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY p.categ_cd

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_dt, p.total_pay FROM ord_hdr h JOIN (SELECT ord_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_pay FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id) p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE h.ord_status = 'D' AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30'
SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2022-06-30' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id DESC
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' ORDER BY ord_dt
SELECT cust_id, signup_dt, DATEDIFF('2022-12-31', signup_dt) AS days_elapsed FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts, DATEDIFF('2026-04-10', opened_ts) AS age_days FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-04-02 00:00:00'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2022-06-30' ORDER BY signup_dt
SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' AND ord_status = 'S'
SELECT currency_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, DATEDIFF('2026-06-30', ord_dt) AS days_to_end FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC
SELECT MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_total, MIN(ord_total_amt) AS min_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND channel_cd = 'WEB'

SELECT c.cust_id, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS order_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
SELECT tier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-10-31', signup_dt)) AS avg_signup_age_days FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku JOIN ord_hdr o ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC
SELECT o.cust_id, o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, p.pay_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' AND p.pay_status = 'S'
SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY total_rfd_amt DESC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku
SELECT currency_cd, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE eff_dt = '2026-01-01' ORDER BY currency_cd
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_cust_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59'
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS actv_cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC
SELECT AVG(l.disc_pct) AS avg_disc_pct FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc
SELECT DATE(opened_ts) AS ticket_dt, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-04-07 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE(opened_ts) ORDER BY ticket_dt
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') ORDER BY region_cd, wh_nm

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY order_month
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY order_month
SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS quarter_no, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY quarter_no

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS signup_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY signup_month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS monthly_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY order_month

WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_dt, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS monthly_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01')) SELECT month_dt, SUM(monthly_amt) OVER (ORDER BY month_dt) AS running_total FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month_dt;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS total_orders FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN refund_req r ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.reason_cd = 'DUP' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm;
SELECT (SELECT ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001') AS total_order_value, (SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001') AS total_payment_amount;
SELECT c.cust_nm, o.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC, c.cust_id ASC
SELECT tkt_id, DATEDIFF(closed_ts, opened_ts) AS resolution_days FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND closed_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59'
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC

SELECT e.emp_nm, COUNT(ev.evt_id) AS close_count FROM emp e JOIN tkt_event ev ON e.emp_id = ev.actor_emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = 'SUP' AND ev.evt_type = 'CLOSE' AND ev.evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND ev.evt_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm
SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd
SELECT MAX(r.rfd_amt) AS max_rfd_amt FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND r.req_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31'
SELECT rule_key, rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2026-04-15' AND (eff_to >= '2026-04-15' OR eff_to IS NULL)

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' WHERE c.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-07-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY ord_count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC

SELECT QUARTER(opened_ts) AS quarter_num, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY QUARTER(opened_ts) ORDER BY quarter_num ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC
SELECT QUARTER(req_dt) AS quarter_num, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(req_dt) ORDER BY quarter_num ASC

SELECT YEAR(opened_ts) AS yr, WEEK(opened_ts, 3) AS wk, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-05-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY YEAR(opened_ts), WEEK(opened_ts, 3) ORDER BY yr ASC, wk ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC

SELECT YEAR(ord_dt) AS yr, QUARTER(ord_dt) AS qtr, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(ord_dt), QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY yr ASC, qtr ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC
SELECT QUARTER(signup_dt) AS quarter_num, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(signup_dt) ORDER BY quarter_num ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND opened_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS req_count FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY year_month ASC

SELECT YEAR(hire_dt) AS yr, QUARTER(hire_dt) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS hire_count FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2021-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(hire_dt), QUARTER(hire_dt) ORDER BY yr ASC, qtr ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(ord_dt), '-', LPAD(WEEK(ord_dt, 3), 2, '0')) AS year_week, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY year_week ORDER BY year_week ASC
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P'
SELECT categ_cd, MAX(sev_lvl) FROM support_tkt GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT tkt_id, COUNT(*) FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd
SELECT o.cust_id, SUM(r.rfd_amt) FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY o.cust_id
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE hire_dt < '2020-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT o.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND o.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ord_hdr.cust_id FROM refund_req JOIN ord_hdr ON refund_req.ord_id = ord_hdr.ord_id) ORDER BY o.cust_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND t.categ_cd = 'BILL' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC
SELECT sku FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct = 0.00 INTERSECT SELECT sku FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct > 0.00 ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' INTERSECT SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' ORDER BY cust_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM ord_line WHERE qty > 2 EXCEPT SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY sku ASC

SELECT approver_emp_id FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND status_cd = 'A' INTERSECT SELECT assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY approver_emp_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' ORDER BY cust_id ASC
SELECT cust_id FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt < '2022-07-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

SELECT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' INTERSECT SELECT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt = '2026-04-04' ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT wh_id FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'ELC-024' AND on_hand_qty > 0 INTERSECT SELECT wh_id FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'ELC-025' AND on_hand_qty > 0 ORDER BY wh_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND m.dept_cd <> 'MGT' ORDER BY e.mgr_emp_id ASC

SELECT actor_emp_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'REPLY' AND actor_emp_id IS NOT NULL EXCEPT SELECT actor_emp_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'ESCAL' AND actor_emp_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY actor_emp_id ASC
SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty > 0 INTERSECT SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND on_hand_qty > 0 ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'PHN' INTERSECT SELECT cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_status = 'D' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_status = 'R' ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT cust_id FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'S' AND is_actv = 1 ORDER BY cust_id ASC
SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'SUP' AND hire_dt < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY emp_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT p.sku FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inv_move m ON p.sku = m.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND p.list_prc > 50.00 AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY p.sku ASC

SELECT c.cust_id FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN refund_req r ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT c2.cust_id FROM cust_master c2 JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON c2.cust_id = o2.cust_id JOIN refund_req r2 ON o2.ord_id = r2.ord_id WHERE r2.reason_cd = 'LAT') ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC
SELECT t1.tkt_id FROM tkt_event t1 JOIN tkt_event t2 ON t1.tkt_id = t2.tkt_id WHERE t1.evt_type = 'OPEN' AND t2.evt_type = 'CLOSE' ORDER BY t1.tkt_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_type = 'CART' AND cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE') ORDER BY cust_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT approver_emp_id AS emp_id FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND approver_emp_id IN (SELECT assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN code_lookup c ON e.dept_cd = c.code_val WHERE c.code_type = 'DEPT' AND c.code_desc LIKE '%support%'
SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P'
SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY cust_nm ASC

SELECT r.rfd_id, r.ord_id, r.rfd_amt FROM refund_req r JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND '2025-12-01' BETWEEN p.eff_from AND COALESCE(p.eff_to, '9999-12-31') WHERE r.rfd_amt > CAST(p.rule_val AS DECIMAL(10,2))

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id JOIN code_lookup cl ON cl.code_type = 'TKT_CATEG' AND cl.code_val = t.categ_cd WHERE cl.code_desc LIKE '%billing%'

SELECT o.ord_id, o.currency_cd, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN (SELECT currency_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY currency_cd) a ON o.currency_cd = a.currency_cd WHERE YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 AND o.ord_total_amt > a.avg_amt ORDER BY o.ord_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY payment_count DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.rfd_amt > 150.00 ORDER BY e.emp_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' AND DATE(t.opened_ts) = '2026-04-03'

SELECT e.tkt_id, e.evt_type, e.evt_ts FROM tkt_event e JOIN (SELECT tkt_id, MAX(evt_ts) AS max_ts FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id) m ON e.tkt_id = m.tkt_id AND e.evt_ts = m.max_ts ORDER BY e.tkt_id ASC
SELECT t.tkt_id, t.cust_id, t.opened_ts FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON t.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 0 ORDER BY t.opened_ts ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN (SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_spend FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id) s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.total_spend > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t.channel_cd) AS channel_count FROM emp e JOIN support_tkt t ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.channel_cd) > 2 ORDER BY channel_count DESC, e.emp_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN refund_req r ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.rfd_amt > (o.ord_total_amt * 0.50) ORDER BY o.ord_id ASC

SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT approver_emp_id FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL) AND emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id ASC
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm HAVING SUM(r.rfd_amt) > 300.00 ORDER BY SUM(r.rfd_amt) DESC

SELECT t.tkt_id, t.opened_ts, t.closed_ts FROM support_tkt t JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'sla_hours_sev1' AND t.opened_ts >= p.eff_from AND (p.eff_to IS NULL OR t.opened_ts <= p.eff_to) WHERE t.sev_lvl = 1 AND t.closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.opened_ts, t.closed_ts) > CAST(p.rule_val AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY t.tkt_id

SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN sev_lvl = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sev_tickets FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY categ_cd

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN sev_lvl = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_tickets FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN closed_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN closed_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31'
SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_requested_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd

SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_requests, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN rfd_amt ELSE 0 END) AS approved_amt_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN rfd_amt ELSE 0 END) AS denied_amt_sum FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd

SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_customers FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

SELECT region_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS active_customer_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND ord_status IN ('D', 'C') GROUP BY ord_status

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_employees, SUM(CASE WHEN mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_manager_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mgr_emp_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_manager_count FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd

SELECT YEAR(hire_dt) AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS total_hires, SUM(CASE WHEN dept_cd = 'SUP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sup_dept_hires FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2021-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(hire_dt)
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_employees, (SUM(CASE WHEN dept_cd IN ('MGT', 'FIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS mgt_fin_percentage FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd

SELECT method_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS settled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status IN ('F', 'R') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_or_refunded_count FROM payment WHERE paid_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY method_cd

SELECT method_cd, currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS settled_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'F' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount FROM payment WHERE paid_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY method_cd, currency_cd
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_warehouses, SUM(CASE WHEN wh_nm LIKE '%Hub%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hub_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd
SELECT mv_type, COUNT(*) AS movement_count, SUM(qty) AS total_qty_moved FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type
SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS total_events, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS distinct_sessions FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY evt_type
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_products, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd

SELECT c.tier_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN t.sev_lvl = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN t.sev_lvl <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_critical_tickets FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON t.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY c.tier_cd

SELECT c.region_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN c.tier_cd = 'P' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS platinum_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN c.tier_cd = 'G' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS gold_revenue FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.region_cd
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00'

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN code_lookup c ON e.dept_cd = c.code_val AND c.code_type = 'DEPT' WHERE c.code_desc LIKE '%support%' AND e.hire_dt < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY e.hire_dt ASC, e.emp_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt >= '2022-07-01'
-- CLARIFY: Which Euro currency code should be used (e.g. EUR)?

SELECT r.rfd_id, r.ord_id, r.rfd_amt FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt >= f.eff_dt WHERE r.status_cd = 'P' AND (r.rfd_amt * f.rate_to_usd) > 100 ORDER BY r.rfd_amt DESC, r.rfd_id ASC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'S' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC
SELECT approver_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND reason_cd = 'DMG' AND approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY approver_emp_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, emp_id ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' AND channel_cd = 'PHN'
SELECT rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND eff_from <= '2026-01-15' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2026-01-15')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tkt_event WHERE actor_emp_id = 'E-010' AND evt_type = 'CLOSE' AND evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL' AND closed_ts IS NULL ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m'), channel_cd ORDER BY ord_month, channel_cd

SELECT wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ship_month, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY wh_id, ship_month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS pay_month, pay_status, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND paid_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m'), pay_status ORDER BY pay_month, pay_status

SELECT QUARTER(s.ship_dt) AS quarter_num, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ord_id) AS unique_orders_shipped, COUNT(DISTINCT s.carrier_cd) AS distinct_carriers FROM shipment s WHERE s.ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(s.ship_dt) ORDER BY quarter_num

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty_moved, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m'), mv_type ORDER BY mv_month, mv_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, SUM(ABS(m.qty)) AS total_units_moved FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON m.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mv_month

SELECT QUARTER(deliv_dt) AS delivery_quarter, YEAR(deliv_dt) AS delivery_year, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_lead_time_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND deliv_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(deliv_dt), YEAR(deliv_dt) ORDER BY delivery_year, delivery_quarter

SELECT m.ord_month, COALESCE(o.total_revenue, 0) AS total_order_revenue, COALESCE(p.total_settled, 0) AS total_settled_payment FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' UNION SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') FROM payment WHERE paid_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59') m LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m')) o ON m.ord_month = o.ord_month LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS pay_month, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m')) p ON m.ord_month = p.pay_month ORDER BY m.ord_month

SELECT w.wh_nm, DATE_FORMAT(s.ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ship_month, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ord_id) AS distinct_orders FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE s.ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY w.wh_nm, DATE_FORMAT(s.ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY w.wh_nm, ship_month

SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS order_quarter, channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_revenue, COUNT(*) AS count_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt), channel_cd ORDER BY order_quarter, total_order_revenue DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ship_month, carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_shipments, COUNT(DISTINCT wh_id) AS warehouses_utilized FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m'), carrier_cd ORDER BY ship_month, carrier_cd

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, SUM(p.list_prc * m.qty) AS total_list_price_sum FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON m.sku = p.sku WHERE m.mv_type = 'IN' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mv_month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(deliv_dt, '%Y-%m') AS deliv_month, wh_id, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_transit_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND deliv_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(deliv_dt, '%Y-%m'), wh_id ORDER BY deliv_month, wh_id

SELECT QUARTER(paid_ts) AS quarter_num, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_settled_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'R' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_refunded_amt FROM payment WHERE paid_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY QUARTER(paid_ts) ORDER BY quarter_num

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty_sold FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m'), p.categ_cd ORDER BY ord_month, p.categ_cd

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS pay_month, method_cd, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled_amount FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m'), method_cd ORDER BY pay_month, method_cd

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, wh_id, COUNT(*) AS adjustment_count, SUM(qty) AS total_qty_adjusted FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m'), wh_id ORDER BY mv_month, wh_id
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_shipments FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT AVG(pay_amt) AS avg_pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S'
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_units_moved FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY sku
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D'
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) > 1500
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY wh_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, wh_id ASC
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS delivered_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY carrier_cd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY delivered_count DESC
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd HAVING SUM(pay_amt) > 500 ORDER BY total_settled DESC
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC
SELECT sku, SUM(-qty) AS total_units_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(-qty) > 3 ORDER BY total_units_out DESC
SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty < i.reorder_pt ORDER BY i.wh_id, i.sku

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) avg_tbl ON p.categ_cd = avg_tbl.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > avg_tbl.avg_prc ORDER BY p.categ_cd, p.list_prc DESC

WITH wh_val AS (SELECT i.wh_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty * p.list_prc) AS val FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku GROUP BY i.wh_id), tot_val AS (SELECT SUM(val) AS gval FROM wh_val) SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, (wv.val / tv.gval) * 100 AS percentage FROM warehouse w JOIN wh_val wv ON w.wh_id = wv.wh_id CROSS JOIN tot_val tv ORDER BY percentage DESC

SELECT ranked.channel_cd, ranked.sku, ranked.tot_qty FROM (SELECT h.channel_cd, l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS tot_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.channel_cd ORDER BY SUM(l.qty) DESC) as rk FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id GROUP BY h.channel_cd, l.sku) ranked WHERE ranked.rk = 1
SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_order_amount, COUNT(*) AS total_order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY channel_cd
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm FROM warehouse w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.wh_id = w.wh_id AND i.on_hand_qty <= 300)

SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, p.settled_amt, (p.settled_amt / h.ord_total_amt) AS ratio FROM ord_hdr h JOIN (SELECT ord_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS settled_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY ord_id) p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id ORDER BY ratio DESC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT w.wh_id FROM warehouse w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m WHERE m.sku = p.sku AND m.wh_id = w.wh_id)) ORDER BY p.sku ASC

SELECT p.categ_cd, p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, MAX(list_prc) AS max_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) m ON p.categ_cd = m.categ_cd AND p.list_prc = m.max_prc ORDER BY p.categ_cd ASC
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'
SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL'
SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ'
SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC'
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND channel_cd = 'WEB'
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0
SELECT ship_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2'
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F'
SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2'
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) a ON i.wh_id = a.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > a.avg_qty

SELECT m.sku, m.mv_id, m.mv_ts FROM inv_move m JOIN (SELECT sku, MAX(mv_ts) AS max_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku) latest ON m.sku = latest.sku AND m.mv_ts = latest.max_ts JOIN (SELECT sku, mv_ts, MAX(mv_id) AS max_id FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku, mv_ts) latest_id ON m.sku = latest_id.sku AND m.mv_ts = latest_id.mv_ts AND m.mv_id = latest_id.max_id
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > (SELECT MAX(reorder_pt) FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1')
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT p.sku, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) c ON p.categ_cd = c.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > c.avg_prc
SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN shipment s ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id WHERE s.ship_id IS NULL

SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, MAX(on_hand_qty) AS max_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) m ON i.wh_id = m.wh_id AND i.on_hand_qty = m.max_qty JOIN (SELECT wh_id, on_hand_qty, MIN(sku) AS min_sku FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id, on_hand_qty) s ON i.wh_id = s.wh_id AND i.on_hand_qty = s.on_hand_qty AND i.sku = s.min_sku

SELECT p.currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_status = 'S' THEN p.pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS settled_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_status = 'R' THEN p.pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_amount FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON p.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY p.currency_cd

SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_or_below_reorder, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty > reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_reorder FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT channel_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.method_cd = 'CC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS credit_card_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.method_cd = 'PP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paypal_count FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON p.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-05-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-05-31'

SELECT carrier_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_transit_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_inventory_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS unique_sku_count FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

SELECT categ_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 0 THEN list_prc ELSE 0 END) AS active_total_list_prc, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN list_prc ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_total_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd

SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN ABS(qty) ELSE 0 END) AS in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN ABS(qty) ELSE 0 END) AS out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_status = 'S' THEN p.pay_amt * f.rate_to_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(p.pay_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS settled_proportion, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_status = 'F' THEN p.pay_amt * f.rate_to_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(p.pay_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS failed_proportion FROM payment p JOIN fx_rate f ON p.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND p.paid_ts >= f.eff_dt AND p.paid_ts < DATE_ADD(f.eff_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status <> 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_delivered_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skus_below_reorder FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id

SELECT currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS web_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS app_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT method_cd, currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_pay_amt FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd, currency_cd
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS delivered_percentage FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT currency_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd IN ('USD', 'EUR') GROUP BY currency_cd

SELECT i.wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN p.categ_cd = 'ELC' THEN i.on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS elc_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN p.categ_cd = 'HOM' THEN i.on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS hom_stock_qty FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku GROUP BY i.wh_id
SELECT currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS settled_to_total_ratio FROM payment GROUP BY currency_cd

SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS restock_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipment_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 0 THEN list_prc END) AS avg_active_list_prc, AVG(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN list_prc END) AS avg_discontinued_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd

SELECT currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'STR' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS str_total_value, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'PHN' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS phn_total_value FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY currency_cd
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'ADJ' THEN ABS(qty) ELSE 0 END) AS total_adjusted_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN ABS(qty) ELSE 0 END) AS total_shipped_qty FROM inv_move
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd IN ('DHL', 'UPS') GROUP BY carrier_cd
SELECT method_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS settled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_at_or_below_reorder FROM inventory
SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND DATE(paid_ts) = '2025-11-01' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-01-08' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND ship_status = 'D' ORDER BY ship_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC, sku ASC
SELECT mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'IN' ORDER BY qty DESC, mv_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' AND ord_total_amt > 100.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT sku, sup_id FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 AND lead_days < 8 ORDER BY lead_days ASC, sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W4' AND on_hand_qty > 500 ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC, wh_id ASC
SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_paid_amt DESC
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd ASC
SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_units_moved FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type IN ('ADJ', 'IN') GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY total_units_moved DESC
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY attempt_count DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line WHERE (unit_prc * qty) > 100.00 GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, wh_id ASC
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 80.00 AND categ_cd IN ('ELC', 'KIT') GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC
SELECT currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_refunded_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'R' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY total_refunded_amt DESC
SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_count FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt GROUP BY w.wh_nm ORDER BY low_stock_count DESC, w.wh_nm ASC

SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(h.ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr h ON s.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE h.ord_status = 'S' AND s.carrier_cd = 'FDX' GROUP BY w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_units FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(l.qty) > 10 ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.prod_nm ASC

SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(p.sku) AS product_count FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC, s.sup_nm ASC
SELECT p.prod_nm, SUM(-m.qty) AS total_moved_qty FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON m.sku = p.sku WHERE m.wh_id = 'W2' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_moved_qty DESC

SELECT w.wh_nm, s.carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE s.carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND w.wh_nm LIKE '%Hub%' GROUP BY w.wh_nm, s.carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
SELECT e1.emp_id, e1.emp_nm FROM emp e1 JOIN emp e2 ON e1.mgr_emp_id = e2.emp_id WHERE e2.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh'
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN code_lookup c ON e.dept_cd = c.code_val AND c.code_type = 'DEPT' WHERE c.code_desc LIKE '%engineering%' AND e.mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.emp_nm = 'Beatrice Owusu'
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dept_cd
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS top_level_count FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.dept_cd = 'MGT'
SELECT e.emp_nm AS employee_name, m.emp_nm AS manager_name FROM emp e LEFT JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id ORDER BY e.emp_nm
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.dept_cd FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.hire_dt < '2019-01-01'
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS top_manager_count FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL GROUP BY dept_cd
SELECT mgr_emp_id AS manager_id, COUNT(*) AS direct_report_count FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

WITH RECURSIVE mgr_tree AS (SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm, m.mgr_emp_id, 1 AS lvl FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.emp_id = 'E-008' UNION ALL SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm, m.mgr_emp_id, t.lvl + 1 FROM mgr_tree t JOIN emp m ON t.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, lvl FROM mgr_tree

WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, s.depth + 1 FROM sub_tree s JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = s.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM sub_tree

WITH RECURSIVE org_depth AS (SELECT emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, d.depth + 1 FROM org_depth d JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = d.emp_id) SELECT MAX(depth) AS max_depth FROM org_depth

WITH RECURSIVE subs AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-002' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.dept_cd FROM subs s JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = s.emp_id) SELECT DISTINCT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM subs

WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM anc a JOIN emp e ON a.mgr_emp_id = e.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM anc WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL
SELECT e.dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS cross_dept_mgr_count FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd <> m.dept_cd GROUP BY e.dept_cd

WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS (SELECT emp_id AS top_id, emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.top_id, e.emp_id FROM sub_tree t JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = t.emp_id) SELECT top_id AS executive_emp_id, COUNT(*) - 1 AS total_subordinate_count FROM sub_tree GROUP BY top_id

WITH RECURSIVE path_cte AS (SELECT emp_id, CAST(emp_id AS CHAR(1000)) AS reporting_path FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, CONCAT(p.reporting_path, ' -> ', e.emp_id) FROM path_cte p JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = p.emp_id) SELECT reporting_path FROM path_cte WHERE emp_id = 'E-006'

WITH RECURSIVE org_lvl AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, 0 AS lvl FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, o.lvl + 1 FROM org_lvl o JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = o.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM org_lvl WHERE lvl = 3
