SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC, s.sup_nm ASC;
SELECT p.prod_nm, s.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku AND ps.is_primary = 1 JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id;
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku;
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_reorder_pt DESC;

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC, p.sku ASC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(ps.sku) > 1 ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, s.sup_nm ASC;
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC;
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(ol.qty * ol.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line ol ON p.sku = ol.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.sku ASC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS primary_product_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_product_count DESC, s.sup_nm ASC;
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(im.mv_id) AS outbound_count FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inv_move im ON w.wh_id = im.wh_id AND im.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY outbound_count DESC;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) > 1000 ORDER BY SUM(i.on_hand_qty) DESC;
SELECT ol.sku, SUM(ol.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN ord_line ol ON oh.ord_id = ol.ord_id WHERE oh.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY ol.sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC;

SELECT s.sup_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country IN ('US', 'CN') GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT i.wh_id) AS wh_count FROM prod_catalog p LEFT JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY wh_count DESC, p.sku ASC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 80;
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';
SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';
SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty < 400;
SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, mv_ts FROM inv_move WHERE DATE(mv_ts) = '2025-10-02';
SELECT sku, wh_id, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days >= 30;
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE prod_nm LIKE 'Atlas%';
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS inventory_record_count FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id;
SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY avg_unit_prc DESC, sku ASC;
SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS prod_count FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm;
SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 20;
SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty_moved FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type;
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm;
SELECT s.sup_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty_ordered FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm;
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku) AS distinct_products FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) > 500;
SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier);

SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS primary_prod_count FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id AND ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_prod_count DESC;
SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, SUM(i.reorder_pt) AS sum_reorder_pt FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM prod_catalog p LEFT JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.list_prc > 100 GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc;

SELECT YEAR(h.ord_dt) AS ord_year, MONTH(h.ord_dt) AS ord_month, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), MONTH(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_year ASC, ord_month ASC;
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT p.categ_cd, DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.categ_cd, ym ORDER BY p.categ_cd ASC, ym ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(qty) AS net_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC
SELECT wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-07-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY wh_id, ym ORDER BY wh_id ASC, ym ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_cust_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, AVG(l.unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT YEAR(mv_ts) AS yr, WEEK(mv_ts, 3) AS wk, SUM(qty) AS total_restock_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY yr, wk ORDER BY yr ASC, wk ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE l.disc_pct > 0 AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT w.region_cd, DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(ABS(m.qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM inv_move m JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE m.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND m.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY w.region_cd, ym ORDER BY w.region_cd ASC, ym ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sku) AS distinct_sku_count FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT l.sku, DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE l.sku = 'ELC-024' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY l.sku, ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, AVG(l.disc_pct) AS avg_disc_pct FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT ps.sup_id, DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(m.qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_supplier ps ON m.sku = ps.sku WHERE m.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND m.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ps.sup_id, ym ORDER BY ps.sup_id ASC, ym ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym ASC

SELECT m.wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(m.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS sum_on_hand FROM inv_move m JOIN inventory i ON m.sku = i.sku AND m.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE m.wh_id = 'W1' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND m.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY m.wh_id, ym ORDER BY ym ASC
SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty DESC
SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE s.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics'
SELECT m.mv_id, m.mv_ts, m.qty FROM inv_move m JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Singapore Hub' AND m.mv_type = 'ADJ'
SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS price_rank FROM prod_catalog
SELECT i1.wh_id, i1.sku, i1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i1 JOIN (SELECT wh_id, MAX(on_hand_qty) AS max_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) m ON i1.wh_id = m.wh_id AND i1.on_hand_qty = m.max_qty
SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS cumulative_qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-026' AND wh_id = 'W3'
SELECT mv_ts, mv_type, qty, LAG(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS prev_qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-025'
SELECT p.sku, s.sup_nm, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 20
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS rk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rk <= 2
SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS running_total FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT sku, sup_id, lead_days, LEAD(lead_days) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY lead_days, sup_id) AS next_lead_days FROM prod_supplier
SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, (list_prc / MAX(list_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd)) * 100 AS price_percentage FROM prod_catalog
SELECT m.mv_id, m.sku, m.qty FROM inv_move m JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku) a ON m.sku = a.sku WHERE m.qty > a.avg_qty
SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) a ON i.wh_id = a.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty < a.avg_qty
SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty, unit_prc, SUM(qty * unit_prc) OVER (ORDER BY ord_id, line_no) AS running_total FROM ord_line
SELECT sup_id, avg_lead, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_lead ASC) AS rk FROM (SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) t
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > reorder_pt
SELECT sku, on_hand_qty, LAG(on_hand_qty) OVER (ORDER BY sku) AS prev_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country, COUNT(ps.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, s.country HAVING COUNT(ps.sku) >= 2 ORDER BY product_count DESC
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT mv_type FROM inv_move ORDER BY mv_type ASC
SELECT sku, lead_days, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 ORDER BY lead_days ASC, sku ASC
SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_units FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_units DESC, sku ASC
SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_nm ASC
SELECT sku, COUNT(sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, sku ASC
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(sku) AS sku_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id;
SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING AVG(unit_prc) > 100 ORDER BY avg_unit_prc DESC;
SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC;
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog) ORDER BY sku;
SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY mv_type;
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.disc_flag = 1 AND i.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY p.sku ASC;
SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-02 00:00:00' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_abs_qty DESC;

WITH sku_totals AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, tot_qty AS total_quantity FROM sku_totals WHERE tot_qty > (SELECT AVG(tot_qty) FROM sku_totals) ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

WITH wh_totals AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_stock FROM wh_totals WHERE total_stock > (SELECT AVG(total_stock) FROM wh_totals) ORDER BY total_stock DESC;

SELECT s.sup_id, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_primary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS primary_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_primary = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_primary_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id ORDER BY s.sup_id;

SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY sku ASC;
SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog p1 WHERE list_prc = (SELECT MAX(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p1.categ_cd) ORDER BY categ_cd;

WITH wh_sum AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(on_hand_qty) AS grand_total FROM inventory) SELECT w.wh_id, w.total_stock, (w.total_stock * 100.0 / t.grand_total) AS percentage FROM wh_sum w CROSS JOIN total_sum t ORDER BY percentage DESC;
SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id HAVING AVG(lead_days) > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier) ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC;

SELECT p.sku, s1.sup_nm AS primary_supplier_name, s2.sup_nm AS secondary_supplier_name FROM prod_catalog p LEFT JOIN prod_supplier ps1 ON p.sku = ps1.sku AND ps1.is_primary = 1 LEFT JOIN supplier s1 ON ps1.sup_id = s1.sup_id LEFT JOIN prod_supplier ps2 ON p.sku = ps2.sku AND ps2.is_primary = 0 LEFT JOIN supplier s2 ON ps2.sup_id = s2.sup_id ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';
SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt;
SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';

SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30;

SELECT t1.wh_nm, t2.on_hand_qty FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-025'
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0

SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-026'
SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 AND sku IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 2)

SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.qty > 3 AND t1.categ_cd <> 'OFC'

SELECT DISTINCT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND t1.sup_id NOT IN (SELECT t4.sup_id FROM prod_supplier AS t4 JOIN prod_catalog AS t5 ON t4.sku = t5.sku WHERE t5.categ_cd = 'KIT')

SELECT t1.wh_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.on_hand_qty > t1.reorder_pt AND t2.region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY t1.wh_id
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC
SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC
SELECT sku, sup_id, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days >= 30 ORDER BY sku ASC, sup_id ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' ORDER BY list_prc DESC
SELECT mv_id, wh_id, mv_ts FROM inv_move WHERE ord_id = 'O-5024' AND mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY mv_id ASC
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 75.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC
SELECT sku, sup_id FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, t1.region_cd FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-024' ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC
SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.sup_id = 1 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_quantity FROM inventory GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC
SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY s.sup_nm

SELECT l.ord_id, l.line_no, l.unit_prc FROM ord_line l JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) a ON l.sku = a.sku WHERE l.unit_prc > a.avg_prc ORDER BY l.ord_id, l.line_no

SELECT p.sku, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) c ON p.categ_cd = c.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > c.avg_prc ORDER BY p.sku

SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) a ON i.wh_id = a.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > a.avg_qty ORDER BY i.sku, i.wh_id

SELECT ps.sup_id, ps.sku FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN (SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) a ON ps.sup_id = a.sup_id WHERE ps.lead_days > a.avg_lead ORDER BY ps.sup_id, ps.sku
SELECT sku FROM inventory GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wh_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse) ORDER BY sku

SELECT ps.sku FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE s.country = 'US' GROUP BY ps.sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.sup_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US') ORDER BY ps.sku

SELECT m.mv_id, m.sku, m.mv_ts FROM inv_move m JOIN (SELECT sku, MAX(mv_ts) AS max_ts FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' GROUP BY sku) latest ON m.sku = latest.sku AND m.mv_ts = latest.max_ts WHERE m.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY m.sku

SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS total_movements, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS restock_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id

SELECT w.region_cd, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(i.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.region_cd ORDER BY w.region_cd

SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN ABS(qty) ELSE 0 END) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id

WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, et.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth AS reporting_depth FROM emp_tree ORDER BY depth ASC, emp_id ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE subordinate_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, 1 AS distance FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-003' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, st.distance + 1 FROM emp e JOIN subordinate_tree st ON e.mgr_emp_id = st.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, distance FROM subordinate_tree ORDER BY distance ASC, emp_id ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_prc * l.disc_pct / 100) AS total_discount FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.decided_dt, '%Y-%m') AS decision_month, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM refund_req r WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' AND r.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND r.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.decided_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY decision_month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr h JOIN cust_master c ON h.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'EU' AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%X-%V') AS tkt_week, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%X-%V') ORDER BY tkt_week ASC

SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) AS rnk FROM ord_hdr

WITH ranked_lines AS (SELECT ord_id, sku, qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id ORDER BY qty DESC, sku ASC) AS rnk FROM ord_line) SELECT l.ord_id, r.max_qty, rl.sku FROM (SELECT ord_id, MAX(qty) AS max_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY ord_id) l JOIN ranked_lines rl ON l.ord_id = rl.ord_id AND rl.qty = l.max_qty AND rl.rnk = 1

WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS lvl FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, o.lvl + 1 FROM emp e JOIN org o ON e.emp_id = o.mgr_emp_id) SELECT DISTINCT emp_id, emp_nm FROM org WHERE lvl > 2

WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT emp_id AS start_id, emp_nm AS start_nm, emp_id AS boss_id FROM emp UNION ALL SELECT o.start_id, o.start_nm, e.mgr_emp_id AS boss_id FROM org o JOIN emp e ON o.boss_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL), top_boss AS (SELECT start_id, start_nm, boss_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY start_id ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) as rn FROM org WHERE boss_id IN (SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL)) SELECT start_id AS emp_id, start_nm AS emp_nm, boss_id AS top_boss_id FROM top_boss GROUP BY start_id, start_nm, boss_id

WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT e.emp_id AS root_id, sub.emp_id AS sub_id, 1 AS hops FROM emp e JOIN emp sub ON sub.mgr_emp_id = e.emp_id UNION ALL SELECT o.root_id, sub.emp_id AS sub_id, o.hops + 1 FROM org o JOIN emp sub ON sub.mgr_emp_id = o.sub_id) DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN org o ON e.emp_id = o.root_id WHERE o.hops >= 2

WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, CAST(emp_nm AS CHAR(1000)) AS path FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, CONCAT(o.path, ' / ', e.emp_nm) FROM emp e JOIN org o ON e.mgr_emp_id = o.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, path FROM org

SELECT rule_id, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE rule_key = 'sla_hours_sev1' AND eff_from <= '2026-05-01' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2026-05-01')
SELECT evt_id, tkt_id, evt_ts, actor_emp_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'CLOSE' AND actor_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2026-04-01'
SELECT sev_lvl, COUNT(*) AS ticket_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC

SELECT t1.ord_status, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt * t2.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN fx_rate t2 ON t1.currency_cd = t2.currency_cd AND t2.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.ord_status ORDER BY total_usd DESC, t1.ord_status ASC
SELECT reason_cd, AVG(rfd_amt) AS avg_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE YEAR(decided_dt) = 2025 GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY avg_rfd_amt DESC, reason_cd ASC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd HAVING tkt_cnt > 1 ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC
SELECT assigned_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, emp_id ASC
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC
SELECT tier_cd, SUM(is_actv) AS active_cust_cnt, MIN(signup_dt) AS min_signup_dt FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY active_cust_cnt DESC, tier_cd ASC

SELECT approver_emp_id AS emp_id, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_approved_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND YEAR(decided_dt) = 2025 AND approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY approver_emp_id ORDER BY total_approved_amt DESC, emp_id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS evt_cnt FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY evt_cnt DESC, evt_type ASC

SELECT approver_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS approved_cnt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY approver_emp_id HAVING approved_cnt > 1 ORDER BY approved_cnt DESC, emp_id ASC
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS emp_cnt FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY emp_cnt DESC, dept_cd ASC

SELECT t1.method_cd, COUNT(*) AS settled_cnt, SUM(t1.pay_amt * t2.rate_to_usd) AS total_settled_usd FROM payment t1 JOIN fx_rate t2 ON t1.currency_cd = t2.currency_cd AND t2.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE t1.pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY t1.method_cd ORDER BY total_settled_usd DESC, t1.method_cd ASC
SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS ship_cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ship_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY ship_cnt DESC, carrier_cd ASC

SELECT currency_cd, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_amt, MIN(ord_total_amt) AS min_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_stock DESC, wh_id ASC

SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_cust_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY distinct_cust_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC

SELECT t1.cust_id, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt * t2.rate_to_usd) AS total_spend FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN fx_rate t2 ON t1.currency_cd = t2.currency_cd AND t2.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.cust_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC, t1.cust_id ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT sev_lvl, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) AS avg_hours_to_close FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND closed_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC
SELECT status_cd, COUNT(*) AS rfd_cnt FROM refund_req WHERE YEAR(req_dt) = 2025 GROUP BY status_cd ORDER BY rfd_cnt DESC, status_cd ASC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS wh_cnt FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY wh_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC
SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS product_count, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY product_count DESC, sup_id ASC
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_units FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty) > 10 ORDER BY total_units DESC, sku ASC
-- UNANSWERABLE: The DEPT code for 'SUP' does not exist in the code_lookup table.
SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P'
SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA'
SELECT rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold'
SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0
-- UNANSWERABLE: The finance department code is not present in the code_lookup table for DEPT.
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP'
SELECT c.cust_nm, t.tkt_id FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON t.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE t.categ_cd = 'BILL'
SELECT r.rfd_id, e.emp_nm FROM refund_req r JOIN emp e ON r.approver_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE r.reason_cd = 'DMG'
SELECT p.prod_nm, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1
SELECT s.cust_id, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN shipment sh ON o.ord_id = sh.ord_id JOIN cust_master s ON o.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE sh.carrier_cd = 'UPS'
SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_nm FROM refund_req r JOIN emp e ON r.approver_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE r.rfd_amt > 100

SELECT e.emp_nm, e.dept_cd, COUNT(t.tkt_id) AS ticket_count FROM emp e LEFT JOIN support_tkt t ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.dept_cd ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, e.emp_nm ASC
SELECT p.prod_nm, p.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'HOM' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm
SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(YEAR(signup_dt)) AS avg_signup_year FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC

SELECT c.cust_nm, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'AP' AND o.ord_total_amt = (SELECT MAX(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = c.cust_id)
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, COUNT(r.rfd_id) AS approval_count FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id HAVING COUNT(r.rfd_id) > 0 ORDER BY approval_count DESC

SELECT m.mth, COALESCE(t.tkt_cnt, 0) AS tkt_cnt, COALESCE(r.rfd_cnt, 0) AS rfd_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01' UNION SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND req_dt < '2027-01-01') m LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m-01')) t ON m.mth = t.mth LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS rfd_cnt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND req_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m-01')) r ON m.mth = r.mth ORDER BY m.mth
SELECT s.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country = 'US' GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_support_tickets FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA'
SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP'
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN'
SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'
SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2026-05-01' AND ends_dt >= '2026-05-01'
SELECT s.carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_cnt FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY s.carrier_cd

SELECT o.ord_id, SUM(p.pay_amt) AS total_settled_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' AND p.pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY o.ord_id
SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY cust_id
SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND l.disc_pct >= 10.00 GROUP BY l.sku
SELECT o.ord_id, COUNT(DISTINCT op.promo_id) AS promo_cnt FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY o.ord_id
SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE decided_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY cust_id
SELECT approver_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rfd_id) AS approved_cnt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND decided_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY approver_emp_id

SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND sev_lvl IN (1, 2) GROUP BY categ_cd

SELECT o.ord_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_line l WHERE l.ord_id = o.ord_id) AS line_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment s WHERE s.ord_id = o.ord_id) AS ship_cnt FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31'
SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) AS ord_cnt, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY cust_id

SELECT o.ord_id, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.pay_id) FROM payment p WHERE p.ord_id = o.ord_id) AS pay_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.rfd_id) FROM refund_req r WHERE r.ord_id = o.ord_id) AS rfd_cnt FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30'
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS sku_cnt, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty > reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

SELECT t.tkt_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.evt_id) AS evt_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.actor_emp_id) AS actor_cnt FROM support_tkt t LEFT JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t.tkt_id

SELECT op.promo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT op.ord_id) AS ord_cnt, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_promo op JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY op.promo_id

SELECT c.cust_id, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.tkt_id) FROM support_tkt t WHERE t.cust_id = c.cust_id) AS tkt_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') AS ord_cnt FROM cust_master c WHERE c.signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND c.signup_dt <= '2022-07-31'

SELECT i.sku, COUNT(DISTINCT i.wh_id) AS wh_cnt, COALESCE(m.total_in_qty, 0) AS total_in_qty FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_in_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku) m ON i.sku = m.sku GROUP BY i.sku, m.total_in_qty
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-04-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-06-30' ORDER BY cust_id ASC
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2018-03-01' AND hire_dt <= '2018-03-31' ORDER BY emp_id
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-01-08' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt = '2025-11-06' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC
SELECT rule_key, rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2025-06-15' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2025-06-15') ORDER BY rule_key ASC
SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-01 23:59:59' ORDER BY tkt_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'
SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, DATEDIFF(decided_dt, req_dt) AS days_to_decide FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND decided_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC

SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, DATEDIFF(closed_ts, opened_ts) AS duration_days FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND closed_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY duration_days DESC, tkt_id ASC
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, DATEDIFF('2026-04-30', opened_ts) AS age_days FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND (closed_ts IS NULL OR closed_ts > '2026-04-30 23:59:59') ORDER BY age_days DESC, tkt_id ASC

SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, c.cust_nm, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' AND o.ord_total_amt > 300.00 ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC, o.ord_id ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS order_count FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-10-31' WHERE c.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-09-30' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.cust_id ASC

SELECT reason_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF(decided_dt, req_dt)) AS avg_days FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY avg_days DESC

SELECT t.categ_cd, t.sev_lvl, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tkt_id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt t JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND DATE(e.evt_ts) = DATE(t.opened_ts) GROUP BY t.categ_cd, t.sev_lvl ORDER BY t.categ_cd ASC, t.sev_lvl ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t.tkt_id, t.opened_ts, t.categ_cd FROM support_tkt t LEFT JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND (t.assigned_emp_id = 'E-006' OR e.actor_emp_id = 'E-006') ORDER BY t.opened_ts ASC, t.tkt_id ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN refund_req r ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.decided_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING total_rfd_amt > 100.00 ORDER BY total_rfd_amt DESC, c.cust_id ASC

SELECT e.actor_emp_id AS emp_id, emp.emp_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT e.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM tkt_event e JOIN emp ON e.actor_emp_id = emp.emp_id WHERE e.evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND e.evt_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND e.actor_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.actor_emp_id, emp.emp_nm HAVING tkt_cnt >= 1 ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, emp_id ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY total_order_amt DESC

SELECT t.tkt_id, t.cust_id, COUNT(e.evt_id) AS event_count FROM support_tkt t JOIN tkt_event e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id WHERE t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.opened_ts <= '2026-04-10 23:59:59' GROUP BY t.tkt_id, t.cust_id HAVING event_count > 1 ORDER BY event_count DESC, t.tkt_id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS sum_totals FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS rfd_month, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY rfd_month

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(opened_ts), '_', WEEK(opened_ts, 1), ' 1'), '%X_%V %W') AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hire_dt, '%Y-%m') AS hire_month, COUNT(*) AS hire_count FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2021-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(hire_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY hire_month

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(opened_ts), '-Q', QUARTER(opened_ts)) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 2 AND opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS rfd_month, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_appr_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY rfd_month
SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(ord_dt)) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(evt_ts), '_', WEEK(evt_ts, 1), ' 1'), '%X_%V %W') AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS purchase_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01' GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, COUNT(*) AS close_cnt FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'CLOSE' AND evt_ts >= '2026-04-01' AND evt_ts < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY evt_month

SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plat_cust, (SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS plat_pct FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC

WITH promo_totals AS (SELECT p.promo_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_val FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_cd) SELECT promo_cd, total_val FROM promo_totals ORDER BY total_val DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT e1.session_id, e1.cust_id, COUNT(e2.evt_id) AS event_count FROM web_event e1 JOIN web_event e2 ON e1.session_id = e2.session_id WHERE e1.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event e3 WHERE e3.session_id = e1.session_id AND e3.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND e3.evt_ts > e1.evt_ts) GROUP BY e1.session_id, e1.cust_id ORDER BY e1.session_id ASC
SELECT segment_cd, month_dt, COUNT(cust_id) AS customer_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt IN ('2026-06-01', '2026-07-01') GROUP BY segment_cd, month_dt ORDER BY segment_cd ASC, month_dt ASC
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, o.ord_id FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'EU' AND signup_dt < '2023-01-01'
SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00
SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP'
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'APP'
SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_id, p.promo_nm FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-04-03'

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND w.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND w.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT oh.cust_id FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr oh ON r.ord_id = oh.ord_id)

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND o.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel_cd) = 2

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND w.sku = 'ELC-024' AND w.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND sku = 'ELC-024' AND evt_type = 'CART')

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'AP' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM support_tkt)

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s1 ON c.cust_id = s1.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist s2 ON c.cust_id = s2.cust_id WHERE s1.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND s1.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND s2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND s2.segment_cd = 'VIP'

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND w.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT w.channel_cd) = 2

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE c.tier_cd = 'S' AND (o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) > 500.00
SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ends_dt <= '2026-12-31'
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND s.segment_cd = 'RISK'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'LA' OR tier_cd = 'P'

SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'EUR' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'GBP')
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE w.sku = 'ELC-025' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr)
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' AND o.channel_cd = 'WEB'
SELECT month_dt, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' ORDER BY month_dt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE promo_id = 3
SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC
SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC
SELECT evt_id, evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001'
SELECT promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC;
SELECT ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.cust_id;
SELECT p.promo_cd, p.promo_nm FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id WHERE op.ord_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.promo_id;

SELECT o1.ord_id, o1.ord_dt, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o1 JOIN (SELECT ord_dt, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_dt) o2 ON o1.ord_dt = o2.ord_dt WHERE o1.ord_total_amt > o2.avg_amt ORDER BY o1.ord_dt, o1.ord_id;

SELECT evt_id, evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' AND session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.month_dt, c.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist c JOIN (SELECT cust_id, MAX(month_dt) AS max_month FROM cust_segment_hist GROUP BY cust_id) latest ON c.cust_id = latest.cust_id AND c.month_dt = latest.max_month WHERE c.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_id;
SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY c.cust_nm;

SELECT op.ord_id, op.promo_id FROM ord_promo op JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN (SELECT op2.promo_id, AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_promo op2 JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON op2.ord_id = o2.ord_id GROUP BY op2.promo_id) avg_tbl ON op.promo_id = avg_tbl.promo_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt <= avg_tbl.avg_amt ORDER BY op.ord_id;
SELECT c.tier_cd, MAX(o.ord_total_amt) AS max_ord_total FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY c.tier_cd;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN (SELECT cust_id, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE (cust_id, month_dt) IN (SELECT cust_id, MAX(month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist GROUP BY cust_id)) latest ON c.cust_id = latest.cust_id JOIN (SELECT cust_id, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE (cust_id, month_dt) IN (SELECT cust_id, MIN(month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist GROUP BY cust_id)) first_seg ON c.cust_id = first_seg.cust_id WHERE latest.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND first_seg.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_id;

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) IN (2025, 2026) EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(o.ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id) ORDER BY c.cust_id;

SELECT w.cust_id, w.session_id, w.evt_ts FROM web_event w JOIN cust_master c ON w.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN (SELECT cust_id, MAX(evt_ts) AS max_ts FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id) m ON w.cust_id = m.cust_id AND w.evt_ts = m.max_ts WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' ORDER BY w.evt_ts, w.cust_id;

SELECT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt, LAG(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS prev_amt FROM ord_hdr) o WHERE o.prev_amt IS NOT NULL AND o.ord_total_amt > o.prev_amt ORDER BY (SELECT ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = o.ord_id), o.ord_id;

SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_cd FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU', 'AP', 'LA') GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.region_cd) = 4 ORDER BY p.promo_id;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS app_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cart_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND evt_ts < '2026-11-01';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vip_count, SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'RISK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS risk_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01';
SELECT tier_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC;

SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usd_orders FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY c.region_cd ASC;

SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' THEN cust_id END) AS recent_signups FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC;
SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC;

SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usd_orders FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC;
SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*), SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

SELECT s.segment_cd, COUNT(s.cust_id), SUM(CASE WHEN c.region_cd = 'NA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_segment_hist s JOIN cust_master c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.segment_cd ORDER BY s.segment_cd ASC

SELECT p.promo_cd, p.disc_pct, COUNT(op.ord_id), (SUM(CASE WHEN o.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(op.ord_id), 0)) FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, p.disc_pct ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(o.ord_id), SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(o.ord_id), 0)) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY c.tier_cd ASC

SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'S' THEN c.cust_id END), (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'S' THEN c.cust_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id), 0)) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY c.region_cd ASC

SELECT s.segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_actv = 1 THEN s.cust_id END), (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_actv = 1 THEN s.cust_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id), 0)) FROM cust_segment_hist s JOIN cust_master c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY s.segment_cd ORDER BY s.segment_cd ASC

SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(op.ord_id), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(op.ord_id), 0)) FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt), SUM(CASE WHEN o.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN o.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.ord_total_amt), 0)) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY c.tier_cd ASC

SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(o.ord_id), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(o.ord_id), 0)) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY c.region_cd ASC

SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM web_event WHERE YEAR(evt_ts) = 2026 GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

SELECT s.segment_cd, COUNT(s.cust_id), SUM(CASE WHEN c.region_cd = 'EU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN c.region_cd = 'NA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN c.region_cd = 'EU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(s.cust_id), 0)) FROM cust_segment_hist s JOIN cust_master c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY s.segment_cd ORDER BY s.segment_cd ASC

SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(o.ord_id), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN o.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(o.ord_id), 0)) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id AND YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY c.tier_cd ASC

SELECT c.region_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 AND o.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 AND o.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 AND o.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(o.ord_dt) = 2026 THEN o.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY c.region_cd ASC
SELECT session_id, MIN(evt_ts) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-01' GROUP BY session_id
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP'
SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 500 AND ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30'
SELECT DISTINCT w.session_id, w.cust_id FROM web_event w JOIN cust_master c ON w.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE DATE(w.evt_ts) = '2025-11-01' AND c.signup_dt < '2025-01-01'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P'
SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct >= 20 AND starts_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-01'
SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_status = 'D' AND YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026
SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) > 1
SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND s.segment_cd = 'RISK'
SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY session_id
SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_dt, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h LEFT JOIN ord_promo p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE h.ord_total_amt > 400 AND p.ord_id IS NULL
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-31'
SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, starts_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_nm LIKE '%offer%' AND starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND starts_dt <= '2026-12-31'
SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS total_views FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt < '2022-06-01'

SELECT t1.cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND t1.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'REG'
SELECT h.ord_id, h.cust_id, h.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_promo op ON h.ord_id = op.ord_id JOIN promo pr ON op.promo_id = pr.promo_id WHERE pr.disc_pct = 15.00
SELECT session_id, evt_ts, sku FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-10 00:00:00'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd IN ('P', 'G') AND region_cd = 'AP'
SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0 AND tier_cd = 'S'

SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, SUM(h.ord_total_amt) AS total_order_amt FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr h ON op.ord_id = h.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd HAVING SUM(h.ord_total_amt) > 1000
SELECT promo_id, promo_nm, disc_pct, ends_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_cd LIKE 'LOYAL%'
SELECT emp_nm, emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001'
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-002' ORDER BY emp_nm ASC
SELECT mgr_emp_id AS manager_emp_id, COUNT(*) AS subordinate_count FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id ORDER BY subordinate_count DESC
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd
SELECT emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2019-12-31' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e LEFT JOIN emp m ON e.emp_id = m.mgr_emp_id WHERE m.emp_id IS NULL
SELECT e1.emp_nm AS chloe_name, e2.emp_nm AS manager_name FROM emp e1 JOIN emp e2 ON e1.mgr_emp_id = e2.emp_id WHERE e1.emp_nm = 'Chloe Whitaker'
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = (SELECT dept_cd FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-003') AND emp_id <> 'E-003'
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY employee_count DESC

WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, et.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM emp_tree

WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS level FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, et.level + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, level FROM emp_tree

WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp_tree

WITH RECURSIVE mgr_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS step FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, mt.step + 1 FROM emp e JOIN mgr_tree mt ON e.emp_id = mt.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, step FROM mgr_tree WHERE emp_id <> 'E-007'

WITH RECURSIVE subordinates AS (SELECT mgr_emp_id AS ancestor_id, emp_id AS desc_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.ancestor_id, e.emp_id FROM subordinates s JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = s.desc_id) SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, COUNT(s.desc_id) AS total_subordinates FROM emp e LEFT JOIN subordinates s ON e.emp_id = s.ancestor_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm ORDER BY total_subordinates DESC, e.emp_id

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd)
SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1
SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = i.wh_id)
SELECT m.mv_id, m.sku, m.wh_id, m.qty FROM inv_move m JOIN (SELECT sku, MAX(mv_ts) AS max_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku) latest ON m.sku = latest.sku AND m.mv_ts = latest.max_ts
SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(ps.sku) > 2
SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC')

SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, i.sku FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id JOIN (SELECT wh_id, MAX(on_hand_qty) AS max_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) m ON i.wh_id = m.wh_id AND i.on_hand_qty = m.max_qty
SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier)
SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT wh_id, MIN(on_hand_qty) AS min_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) m ON i.wh_id = m.wh_id AND i.on_hand_qty = m.min_qty
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps1 ON p.sku = ps1.sku AND ps1.sup_id = 1 JOIN prod_supplier ps2 ON p.sku = ps2.sku AND ps2.sup_id = 6
SELECT m.sku, m.wh_id, m.mv_ts FROM inv_move m JOIN (SELECT wh_id, MIN(mv_ts) AS min_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id) t ON m.wh_id = t.wh_id AND m.mv_ts = t.min_ts
SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING MAX(ps.lead_days) > 30
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_count, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM prod_catalog
SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_stock_count FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_movement_qty, COUNT(*) AS count_movements FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type
SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS total_products, SUM(is_primary) AS primary_products FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_movements, SUM(CASE WHEN qty > 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS sum_positive_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN qty < 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS sum_negative_qty FROM inv_move
SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS distinct_skus, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_reorder_count FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_products, SUM(disc_flag) AS discontinued_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT ps.sup_id, COUNT(ps.sku) AS product_count, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps GROUP BY ps.sup_id ORDER BY ps.sup_id
SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(i.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm
SELECT p.categ_cd, COUNT(l.ord_id) AS total_order_lines, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty_ordered FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd

SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'ADJ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adj_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM supplier GROUP BY country ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, country ASC
SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_products, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_price, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_above_50 FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT sup_id, MIN(lead_days) AS min_lead_days, MAX(lead_days) AS max_lead_days, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id
SELECT wh_id, SUM(reorder_pt - on_hand_qty) AS total_inventory_deficit FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT w.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT w.wh_id) AS warehouse_count, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.region_cd
SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS sku_count, SUM(is_primary) AS primary_sku_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id
SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty_moved, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku
SELECT categ_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_le_50, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_gt_50 FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT sup_id, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30 GROUP BY sup_id
SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT categ_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS discontinued_pct FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd
SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty > reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS health_pct FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
SELECT t1.sup_id, (SUM(t1.is_primary) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS primary_pct FROM prod_supplier AS t1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id
SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC
SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) > 800 ORDER BY p.prod_nm ASC, p.sku ASC
SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country, ps.sku FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country <> 'US' AND ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 30 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC, ps.sku ASC
SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC
SELECT wh_id, ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) <= 3 ORDER BY ship_id ASC
SELECT sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty < 0 ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC
SELECT sku, ord_id, qty FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 4 ORDER BY qty DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 0 AND ps.lead_days >= 20 ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC, s.sup_nm ASC
SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > 300 AND w.region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty DESC, i.sku ASC
SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 80.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC
SELECT sku, wh_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-07 23:59:59' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, sku ASC
SELECT sku, COUNT(sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, sku ASC

SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, s.sup_nm, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 25 ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC, p.sku ASC

SELECT w.wh_nm, i.sku, p.prod_nm, i.on_hand_qty, i.reorder_pt FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt AND p.disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty ASC, i.sku ASC

SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_nm, s.country FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country = 'US' AND ps.lead_days < 20 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC
SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('AP', 'EU') ORDER BY region_cd ASC, wh_id ASC

SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT p.categ_cd) AS cat_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.categ_cd) >= 2 ORDER BY cat_count DESC, s.sup_id ASC
SELECT ord_id, sku, qty, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 3 AND unit_prc > 100.00 ORDER BY unit_prc DESC, ord_id ASC
SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country, ps.sku FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country <> 'US' AND ps.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC, ps.sku ASC
SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days < 15 ORDER BY lead_days ASC, sup_id ASC;

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh';
SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.emp_id = 'E-002';
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL;
SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY employee_count DESC;
SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2019-01-01';
SELECT emp_nm, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-005';
SELECT DISTINCT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = 'ENG';
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m1 ON e.mgr_emp_id = m1.emp_id JOIN emp amara ON m1.mgr_emp_id = amara.emp_id WHERE amara.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh';
SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.dept_cd = 'FIN';
SELECT e.dept_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) AS total_employees FROM emp e JOIN emp sub ON sub.mgr_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = sub.dept_cd GROUP BY e.dept_cd;
SELECT DISTINCT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp m JOIN emp d ON d.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id JOIN emp s ON s.mgr_emp_id = d.emp_id;
SELECT m.emp_nm, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS direct_reports_count FROM emp m JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_id, m.emp_nm ORDER BY direct_reports_count DESC;
SELECT dept_cd, AVG(YEAR(hire_dt)) AS avg_hire_year FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd;

WITH RECURSIVE org_chart AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, o.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN org_chart o ON e.mgr_emp_id = o.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM org_chart;

WITH RECURSIVE subordinates AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN subordinates s ON e.mgr_emp_id = s.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM subordinates;

WITH RECURSIVE reporting_chain AS (SELECT emp_id, mgr_emp_id, CAST(emp_id AS CHAR(200)) AS path FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.mgr_emp_id, CONCAT(rc.path, ' -> ', e.emp_id) FROM emp e JOIN reporting_chain rc ON e.emp_id = rc.mgr_emp_id) SELECT path FROM reporting_chain WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL;

WITH RECURSIVE org_depth AS (SELECT emp_id AS root_id, emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.root_id, e.emp_id, o.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN org_depth o ON e.mgr_emp_id = o.emp_id) SELECT root_id, MAX(depth) AS max_depth FROM org_depth GROUP BY root_id;

WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS (SELECT mgr_emp_id AS manager_id, emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT st.manager_id, e.emp_id FROM emp e JOIN sub_tree st ON e.mgr_emp_id = st.emp_id) SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm, COUNT(st.emp_id) AS total_subordinates FROM emp m LEFT JOIN sub_tree st ON m.emp_id = st.manager_id GROUP BY m.emp_id, m.emp_nm;

WITH RECURSIVE managers AS (SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN emp target ON e.emp_id = target.mgr_emp_id WHERE target.emp_id = 'E-008' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN managers m ON e.emp_id = m.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM managers;

WITH RECURSIVE root_mgr AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_id AS root_id, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, rm.root_id, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN root_mgr rm ON e.mgr_emp_id = rm.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, root_id FROM root_mgr;

SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS discontinued_on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.disc_flag = 1

SELECT SUM(ol.qty * ol.unit_prc * (ol.disc_pct / 100.0)) AS total_discount_value FROM ord_line ol
